aaron.title: Aaron
aaron.about: High Priest living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
aaron.note: Moses's older brother, and the one God sent to do the talking when Moses said he could not. He became Israel's first high priest, and the priesthood ran through his sons after him. Most of the time he is standing next to Moses.

abarim.title: Abarim
abarim.note: A range of mountains east of the Dead Sea, looking across at Jericho. Mount Nebo is the peak in it that people know, because that is where Moses stood to see the land he was not going to enter. Israel camped here at the end of the wilderness years.

abihu.title: Abihu
abihu.about: Priest living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
abihu.note: Aaron's second son. He and his brother Nadab brought fire the Lord had not asked for and died on the spot, and Aaron was not allowed to mourn them in public.

abiram.title: Abiram
abiram.about: Aaron's adversary living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
abiram.note: He and Dathan went in with Korah against Moses and Aaron. The ground opened and took him, his household and the rest of them down alive.

agag-2.title: Agag
agag-2.about: King living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
agag-2.note: Numbers names him once, and he is a king from the wilderness years.

ahiram.title: Ahiram
ahiram.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
ahiram.note: Benjamin's son, and the man the Ahiramite clan in the Numbers 26 census came from. Genesis 46:21 probably calls him Ehi.

ahiramites.title: Ahiramites
ahiramites.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
ahiramites.note: The clan descended from Ahiram, Benjamin's son, counted in the Numbers 26 census.

almighty.title: Almighty
almighty.note: It translates El Shaddai, a Hebrew title for God used most in the stories of the patriarchs and in Job. It describes who God is and what he can do, and it is not anyone's name.

amalek.title: Amalek
amalek.note: Esau's grandson. The Amalekites who came from him attacked the weak rear of Israel's column in the wilderness, and God declared war on Amalek for it. Saul's half-done obedience against them later cost him the kingdom.

ammon.title: Ammon
ammon.note: A nation east of the Jordan, descended from Lot through his younger daughter and close kin to Moab. The Ammonites fought Israel again and again, from Jephthah's war in Judges to the insult to David's envoys that started a full war in David's reign.

amorite.title: Amorite
amorite.note: One of the peoples in Canaan before Israel came, traced in Genesis 10 to a son of Canaan, and sometimes used loosely for everyone in the hill country. Sihon and Og ruled an Amorite kingdom east of the Jordan that fell to Israel under Moses. Outside the Bible they are the Amurru of Mesopotamian texts, the people whose dynasty produced Hammurabi of Babylon.

amram.title: Amram
amram.about: Moses' father living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
amram.note: The father of Aaron, Moses and Miriam. He was a Levite and married his father's sister Jochebed, and beyond that little is recorded about him.

ar.title: Ar
ar.note: The chief city of Moab on the Arnon, so central that "Ar of Moab" could stand for Moab itself. God told Israel to leave it alone on the way through. Its ruins survive at Rabba in modern Jordan.

arad.title: Arad
arad.note: Its king attacked Israel as they came up toward Canaan from the south and took prisoners, and Israel destroyed the town under the ban. The Canaanite city lay about 20 miles south of Hebron, at Tel Arad.

aram.title: Aram
aram.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
aram.note: It is what the Old Testament calls Syria, the region and people centred on Damascus. Under kings like Ben-hadad and Hazael it fought both Israelite kingdoms again and again.

ard-2.title: Ard
ard-2.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
ard-2.note: A grandson of Benjamin through Bela, and the ancestor of the Ardites. Chronicles calls him Addar.

ardites.title: Ardites
ardites.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
ardites.note: The clan from Ard, Benjamin's grandson through Bela, counted in the Numbers 26 census.

areli.title: Areli
areli.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
areli.note: He went down to Egypt with Jacob among the seventy, a son of Gad, and his clan, the Arelites, was counted again in the wilderness census.

arnon.title: Arnon
arnon.note: A swift river running into the Dead Sea from the east, the line between Amorite and later Moabite land and Israel's tribes beyond the Jordan. Its gorge still carries water in the Wadi al-Mujib. King Mesha of Moab's inscription, the Moabite Stone, boasts of building a highway across it.

arod.title: Arod
arod.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
arod.note: A son of Gad, ancestor of the Arodite clan in the census of Numbers 26:17. Genesis 46:16 calls him Arodi.

arodi.title: Arodi
arodi.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
arodi.note: Arod again, under the spelling Genesis uses: Gad's son, founder of the Arodite clan, and one of the seventy who went down to Egypt with Jacob.

ashbel.title: Ashbel
ashbel.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
ashbel.note: Benjamin's son, and his descendants made one of the clans of the tribe.

ashbelites.title: Ashbelites
ashbelites.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
ashbelites.note: Counted in the Numbers 26 census, the clan that came from Ashbel, Benjamin's son.

asher.title: Asher
asher.about: Jacob's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
asher.note: Jacob's eighth son, by Leah's servant Zilpah. His tribe got a fertile coastal strip in the north, running toward Phoenicia, some of the richest land in Israel. Beyond its borders and city list little of the tribe's own history is recorded, and like Simeon it produced no judge or great hero.

ashriel.title: Ashriel
ashriel.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
ashriel.note: Asriel, from Manasseh. His family made one of the tribe's clans.

asrielites.title: Asrielites
asrielites.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
asrielites.note: The clan from Asriel, Manasseh's grandson through Gilead, in the Numbers 26 census.

asshur.title: Asshur
asshur.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
asshur.note: Shem's son, whose name stuck to the land and empire of Assyria on the upper Tigris. Assyria became the great power of the eighth and seventh centuries BC, deported Israel's northern tribes after Samaria fell, and kept threatening Judah.

baal-peor.title: Baal-peor
baal-peor.about: A male deity in the Old Testament
baal-peor.note: Israel, nearly at the promised land, got drawn into worshipping this Moabite god through Moabite women. A plague followed, and it took Phinehas acting in zeal to stop it.

bachrites.title: Bachrites
bachrites.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
bachrites.note: Becher's clan, from a son of Ephraim, counted in the Numbers 26 census.

balaam.title: Balaam
balaam.about: Prophet living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
balaam.note: A prophet, but not an Israelite. Balak of Moab hired him to curse the Israelites. On the way his donkey saw an angel blocking the road that Balaam himself missed, and God made the animal speak to rebuke him.

balak.title: Balak
balak.about: King living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
balak.note: The Moabite king who paid Balaam to curse Israel and got blessings instead, oracle after oracle. His temper fraying each time is one of the darkly comic threads in Numbers.

bamoth.title: Bamoth
bamoth.note: Heights. That was the name of one of Israel's wilderness camps, in Moabite country. It is likely tied to Bamoth-baal, the high place where Balak later took Balaam to curse Israel.

bashan.title: Bashan
bashan.note: The fertile tableland east of the Jordan, between Gilead and Mount Hermon. Og ruled it, the last of the Rephaim, until Israel beat him and gave the land to half the tribe of Manasseh.

becher-2.title: Becher
becher-2.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
becher-2.note: Numbers names him once, and he is a man from the wilderness years.

beer.title: Beer
beer.note: Beer means well, and two places carry it. One was a stop in the wilderness of Moab where Israel's leaders dug a well and a short song was sung over it; the other is in Judges 9:21.

beerites.title: Beerites
beerites.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
beerites.note: Beriah's clan, from a son of Asher, counted in the Numbers 26 census.

bela.title: Bela
bela.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
bela.note: Two things go by this name in these verses. Bela, also called Zoar, was the one city of the plain spared, kept so Lot had somewhere near to run. The name also belongs to Benjamin's firstborn son.

belaites.title: Belaites
belaites.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
belaites.note: Descended from Bela, Benjamin's firstborn, and counted in the Numbers 26 census as a clan.

benjamin.title: Benjamin
benjamin.about: Jacob's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
benjamin.note: Jacob's twelfth son and the youngest, born to Rachel on the road near Bethlehem as she died giving birth to him. Jacob guarded him fiercely after losing Joseph. That fear drives much of the tension in Joseph's story.

beor.title: Beor
beor.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
beor.note: Balaam's father, named whenever Balaam is called son of Beor.

beriah.title: Beriah
beriah.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
beriah.note: A son of Asher, and the head of a clan in the Numbers 26 census. Several other men carry the same name.

cain.title: Cain
cain.about: Man living at the time before the Flood
cain.note: Adam and Eve's firstborn, a farmer. God accepted his brother Abel's offering and not his, and Cain killed Abel out of jealousy. God marked him and sent him off to wander rather than putting him to death.

caleb.title: Caleb
caleb.about: Joshua's compatriot living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness and Conquest
caleb.note: One of the twelve spies Moses sent into Canaan. He and Joshua were the only two who came back telling Israel to trust God and take the land, and the rest of that generation paid for ignoring them with forty years in the wilderness.

canaan.title: Canaan
canaan.note: The land promised to Abraham and his descendants, roughly modern Israel and the land around it. The conquest under Joshua is that promise, centuries old by then, being kept.

canaanite.title: Canaanite
canaanite.note: They were the people living in the land promised to Israel. The biblical genealogy traces them to Canaan, son of Ham. The Old Testament repeatedly orders them driven out because of their idol worship and other practices.

carmi.title: Carmi
carmi.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
carmi.note: Reuben's son, whose family became one of the tribe's clans.

chemosh.title: Chemosh
chemosh.about: A male deity in the Old Testament
chemosh.note: Moab's national god. Solomon built him a shrine to please one of his foreign wives, and that is among the reasons given for the enemies God raised against Solomon late in his reign.

chittim.title: Chittim
chittim.note: Kittim was a son of Javan, and the name stretched to cover the islands and coasts of the eastern Mediterranean, Cyprus most of all. In prophecy it stands for far-off peoples who come by sea.

cozbi.title: Cozbi
cozbi.about: Woman living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
cozbi.note: Daughter of Zur, a Midianite chief. Phinehas the priest killed her and the Israelite Zimri together at Baal-peor, and the plague that came with it was remembered as a warning.

dathan.title: Dathan
dathan.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
dathan.note: He and Abiram joined Korah against Moses, and the ground opened under their tents and took them and their families.

dibon.title: Dibon
dibon.note: A Moabite city Israel took and rebuilt. King Mesha names it on the Moabite Stone as one of his own building projects.

eber.title: Eber
eber.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
eber.note: Several generations before Abraham in Shem's line, and his name is the likely source of the word Hebrew.

edom.title: Edom
edom.note: Esau got the byname Edom over a bowl of red stew, and it stuck to the mountain country his descendants settled southeast of the Dead Sea. Bozrah was its old capital and Sela, the Greeks' Petra, its rock fortress. Edom refused Israel passage in the exodus and later helped Babylon sack Jerusalem, and the prophets did not let that go.

edrei.title: Edrei
edrei.note: Israel met Og, king of Bashan, here, and his whole kingdom fell in that one battle.

egypt.title: Egypt
egypt.note: Joseph rose to power there and kept his family alive through the famine. A later pharaoh enslaved their descendants, and that set up the exodus. For the rest of the Old Testament Egypt stands for the slavery Israel was brought out of, and Matthew has Jesus's family flee there from Herod as if living that story again.

eleazar.title: Eleazar
eleazar.about: High Priest living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
eleazar.note: Aaron's third son. Nadab and Abihu died for offering unauthorized fire, and Eleazar became high priest after his father. He worked with Moses on the second census and with Joshua on dividing the land, and his line held the high priesthood for most of the history after.

eliab-3.title: Eliab
eliab-3.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
eliab-3.note: His sons were in the wilderness rebellion of Numbers 16 and went down when the ground opened. Deuteronomy 11:6 recalls them by naming him.

elon-2.title: Elon
elon-2.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
elon-2.note: Genesis and Numbers name him twice, and he is a man from the wilderness years.

elonites.title: Elonites
elonites.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
elonites.note: The clan from Elon, a son of Zebulun, counted in the wilderness census and not to be mixed up with the later judge.

ephraim.title: Ephraim
ephraim.about: Joseph's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
ephraim.note: Joseph's younger son. When Jacob blessed the two boys he crossed his hands on purpose and gave Ephraim the bigger blessing over Manasseh. The tribe came to dominate the north so much that the prophets use Ephraim for the whole northern kingdom.

er.title: Er
er.note: Judah's firstborn. Genesis says only that he was wicked in the Lord's sight and God put him to death, and his widow Tamar's story starts from there.

eran.title: Eran
eran.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
eran.note: Son of Shuthelah and grandson of Ephraim, and the ancestor of the Eranites in the wilderness census.

eranites.title: Eranites
eranites.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
eranites.note: The clan from Eran, Ephraim's grandson through Shuthelah, as the census counted them.

eri.title: Eri
eri.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
eri.note: A son of Gad who went down to Egypt with Jacob's family. His descendants were the Erites of the wilderness census.

erites.title: Erites
erites.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
erites.note: Eri's descendants, a clan of Gad counted in the census.

gad.title: Gad
gad.about: Jacob's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
gad.note: Jacob's seventh son, born to Leah's servant Zilpah. His tribe asked for good pasture east of the Jordan and got it. The condition was that Gad's fighting men still crossed over and helped the other tribes take their land first.

gershom.title: Gershom
gershom.note: These verses are the census ones, Genesis 46:11, Exodus 6:16 and Numbers 3 and 4, where his family is counted and given its share of the tabernacle work. The note filed with them describes Moses's firstborn, born in Midian and named for a stranger there, who is a different man.

gilead-2.title: Gilead
gilead-2.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
gilead-2.note: The man, not the region. Numbers 26 and Joshua 17 put him in Manasseh's family, and Chronicles lists him there again.

gileadite.title: Gileadite
gileadite.note: Someone from Gilead, east of the Jordan, or of the clan named after Machir's son. Jephthah is the best known, the judge who beat the Ammonites and made the rash vow about his daughter.

guni.title: Guni
guni.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
guni.note: One of Naphtali's sons, and a clan of the tribe came from him.

gunites.title: Gunites
gunites.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
gunites.note: The clan from Guni, Naphtali's son. They were counted in the census of Numbers 26 on the plains of Moab, before Israel crossed into Canaan.

haggi.title: Haggi
haggi.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
haggi.note: Gad's second son, one of the seventy who went down into Egypt. The Haggite clan in the wilderness census came from him, and nothing else is recorded.

hamul.title: Hamul
hamul.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
hamul.note: Perez's son and Judah's grandson. One of Judah's clans came from him.

hamulites.title: Hamulites
hamulites.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
hamulites.note: Counted in the Numbers 26 census, the clan of Hamul, Judah's grandson through Pharez.

hanochites.title: Hanochites
hanochites.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
hanochites.note: Reuben's eldest son was Hanoch, and this clan, counted in the wilderness census, came from him.

heber.title: Heber
heber.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
heber.note: Not the Kenite. This Heber is in Genesis 46:17 among the family that went down to Egypt, and Numbers 26:45 makes him the head of a clan.

heberites.title: Heberites
heberites.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
heberites.note: Counted in Numbers 26, the clan of Heber, Asher's grandson through Beriah.

hebronites.title: Hebronites
hebronites.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
hebronites.note: They were Levites of Kohath's line, through his son Hebron. Under David they were put over Israelite land west of the Jordan and over treasuries tied to the temple.

helek.title: Helek
helek.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
helek.note: From Manasseh through Gilead, he headed the Helekite clan, counted in the census and given land.

helkites.title: Helkites
helkites.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
helkites.note: They came from Helek, Manasseh's grandson through Gilead, and got a share of the land.

hepher.title: Hepher
hepher.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
hepher.note: Gilead's son, of Manasseh, and the father of Zelophehad. Zelophehad had five daughters and no son, and their case before Moses won daughters the right to inherit.

hepherites.title: Hepherites
hepherites.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness

heshbon.title: Heshbon
heshbon.note: Sihon's capital, east of the Jordan near the northern edge of Moab. Moses took it before Israel crossed into Canaan, and it became a Levitical city in Reuben. Moab later had it back, which is why the prophets name it in their judgments on Moab, and the ruins, still called Hesban, lie about twenty miles east of the Jordan.

hezron.title: Hezron
hezron.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
hezron.note: Perez's son, and the line that ends in David runs through him; Ruth closes with it and Matthew picks it up. The same name marks a spot on Judah's southern border, west of Kadesh-barnea.

hezronites.title: Hezronites
hezronites.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
hezronites.note: Two clans in the wilderness census carried this name. One came from Reuben's son Hezron, the other from Judah's line through Perez, and that second one is David's own family.

hoglah.title: Hoglah
hoglah.about: Woman living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
hoglah.note: One of Zelophehad's five daughters. They asked Moses for their father's land, got it, and set a precedent for Israel.

hor.title: Hor
hor.note: Aaron died on Mount Hor, at the edge of Edom near the end of the wandering. His priestly garments were taken off him in sight of the people, and they buried him on the mountain.

hormah.title: Hormah
hormah.note: Its name means "devoted to destruction", and it was first called Zephath. Israel was beaten there after going into Canaan without the Lord, following the spies' report. Later Israel vowed to destroy the cities of the region, and the vow, kept under Joshua, gave the town its name.

hupham.title: Hupham
hupham.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
hupham.note: Benjamin's son, and the Huphamite clan in the wilderness census comes from him. Genesis and Chronicles call him Huppim.

huphamites.title: Huphamites
huphamites.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
huphamites.note: They were Hupham's clan, counted in the census of Numbers 26.

ije-abarim.title: Ije-abarim
ije-abarim.note: They camped here on the border of Moab late in the journey from Egypt. The name means "ruins of Abarim", after the range east of the Jordan, and the camp itself has not been found.

imna.title: Imna
imna.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
imna.note: A son of Asher. Genesis, Numbers and Chronicles all list him. Numbers counts a clan from him.

ishuai.title: Ishuai
ishuai.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
ishuai.note: One of the household that went down to Egypt, named again in the Numbers census with a clan of his own and once more in Chronicles.

israel.title: Israel
israel.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
israel.note: God gave Jacob this name after he wrestled through the night at Peniel. It became the name of the nation that came from his twelve sons, and later of the northern kingdom and of the land. For the man himself, see Jacob.

isri.title: Isri
isri.about: Levite living at the time of United Monarchy
isri.note: In the census of Numbers 26 this is the clan from Jezer, Naphtali's son, rather than one man.

issachar.title: Issachar
issachar.about: Jacob's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
issachar.note: Jacob's ninth son. His tribe held the fertile Jezreel Valley, and Chronicles says its men understood the times and knew what Israel ought to do.

ithamar.title: Ithamar
ithamar.about: Priest living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
ithamar.note: Aaron's youngest son. Two of his brothers died for offering unauthorized fire and Eleazar became high priest, and Ithamar was put over the Levites who carried and kept the tabernacle. Eli came from his line, which held the high priesthood for a while before it went back to Eleazar's line under Zadok.

jaazer.title: Jaazer
jaazer.note: Jazer, an Amorite town in Gilead east of the Jordan. Israel took it and gave it to Gad, then to the Levites of Merari. Isaiah and Jeremiah both use its ruined vineyards as a picture of Moab's ruin.

jabbok.title: Jabbok
jabbok.note: Jacob crossed this stream alone the night before he met Esau, wrestled until daybreak, and came away named Israel and limping. It runs west into the Jordan through a gorge in Gilead, halfway between the Sea of Galilee and the Dead Sea, and is the Zarqa River today.

jachin.title: Jachin
jachin.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
jachin.note: One of the men who went down to Egypt, and a clan is counted from him in the Numbers census. The same name, meaning "he shall establish", was given to one of the temple's two bronze pillars.

jachinites.title: Jachinites
jachinites.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
jachinites.note: Jachin's clan, from Simeon's line, counted in the census of Numbers 26.

jacob.title: Jacob
jacob.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
jacob.note: Isaac and Rebekah's younger twin, born holding Esau's heel. He bought his brother's birthright for stew, took his father's blessing by a trick, and ran to his uncle Laban, where he worked fourteen years for Leah and Rachel. On the way home he wrestled all night and came away named Israel. He died in Egypt, near Joseph, and was buried at Machpelah as he had asked.

jahleel.title: Jahleel
jahleel.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
jahleel.note: Zebulun's third son, and the Jahleelite clan came from him.

jahleelites.title: Jahleelites
jahleelites.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
jahleelites.note: Jahleel's clan, from Zebulun, in the wilderness census.

jahzeel.title: Jahzeel
jahzeel.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
jahzeel.note: The first of Naphtali's four sons, who went down to Egypt with Jacob's household. The Jahzeelites came from him, and nothing else is recorded of him.

jahzeelites.title: Jahzeelites
jahzeelites.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
jahzeelites.note: Counted in the census of Numbers 26, the clan that came from Jahzeel, Naphtali's firstborn.

jamin.title: Jamin
jamin.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
jamin.note: One of Simeon's sons, in Genesis, Exodus, Numbers and Chronicles. The name was common.

jashub.title: Jashub
jashub.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
jashub.note: Issachar's son, and his clan was counted in the census of Numbers.

jashubites.title: Jashubites
jashubites.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
jashubites.note: Jashub's clan, of Issachar, counted in Numbers 26. The King James has him as Job in Genesis 46:13.

jeezer.title: Jeezer
jeezer.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
jeezer.note: Head of the Jeezerite clan among the Manassites in the wilderness census. Elsewhere the name is Abiezer, and Gideon came from that clan.

jehoshua.title: Jehoshua
jehoshua.about: Judge living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness and Conquest
jehoshua.note: Joshua, in the longer spelling. Moses's attendant and successor, and one of two from the generation out of Egypt who lived to enter the land. He took Israel over the Jordan, brought down Jericho and divided the land among the tribes. The name means Yahweh saves, the same name Greek renders Jesus.

jephunneh.title: Jephunneh
jephunneh.about: Caleb's father living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
jephunneh.note: Caleb's father, remembered almost entirely as a name in "Caleb son of Jephunneh", which is how the Old Testament tells that Caleb apart from the others.

jericho.title: Jericho
jericho.note: Israel crossed the Jordan and Jericho was the first city it took, walled and gated, with its own king. Achan died for what he stole from the plunder there, a Babylonian robe and silver that belonged to God. By then the place was already ancient: digging at the site has turned up remains about ten thousand years old.

jesuites.title: Jesuites
jesuites.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
jesuites.note: They were Jesui's clan. He was Asher's son, also spelled Ishvi. The Numbers 26 census counts them.

jezer.title: Jezer
jezer.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
jezer.note: He was Naphtali's son. His family became one of Naphtali's clans.

jezerite.title: Jezerite
jezerite.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
jezerite.note: In the Numbers 26 census, the clan of Jeezer, also called Abiezer, Gilead's son, in Manasseh. It is the same Abiezrite family Gideon was born into, and his hometown Ophrah belonged to it.

jochebed.title: Jochebed
jochebed.about: Woman living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
jochebed.note: The mother of Miriam, Aaron and Moses, and Amram's wife. She hid Moses for three months, set him in a basket on the Nile, and was then paid to nurse her own son for Pharaoh's daughter.

jordan.title: Jordan
jordan.note: It runs from the slopes of Mount Hermon through the Sea of Galilee and down the Rift Valley to the Dead Sea, about sixty five miles in a straight line and nearer two hundred as the river winds. Israel crossed it on dry ground under Joshua, Elijah and Elisha each parted it, and John the Baptist baptised Jesus in it.

joseph.title: Joseph
joseph.about: Jacob's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
joseph.note: Jacob's eleventh son and Rachel's first. His father's favouritism and his own tactless dreams got him sold into Egypt by his brothers, and there he rose from slave to prisoner to second in the land by reading Pharaoh's dreams of famine. When the famine drove his brothers down for grain, he told them who he was and forgave them.

judah.title: Judah
judah.about: Jacob's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
judah.note: Leah's fourth son, and the brother who ends up leading. He talked the others into selling Joseph rather than killing him, and later offered himself as a hostage in Benjamin's place. His tribe produced David's royal line and gave its name to the southern kingdom, and Jacob's dying blessing promised the sceptre would not leave him.

kadesh.title: Kadesh
kadesh.note: Kadesh-barnea, Israel's main camp in the wilderness of Zin. Moses sent the twelve spies from there, Miriam died there, and there he struck the rock and lost his way into Canaan. It is usually identified with Ain el-Qudeis or Ain el-Qudeirat, where a fortress of the Israelite period has been dug up.

kenite.title: Kenite
kenite.note: They were a wandering clan close to Midian, outside the twelve tribes but mostly friendly to Israel. Jethro, Moses' father-in-law, was a Kenite priest, and Jael, Heber the Kenite's wife, killed Sisera.

kirjath-huzoth.title: Kirjath-huzoth
kirjath-huzoth.note: Balak, king of Moab, met Balaam in this town, "city of streets," after sending to the Euphrates to have him curse Israel. It lay near the high places where Balaam later looked down on the camp.

kohath.title: Kohath
kohath.about: Levi's son living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
kohath.note: Levi's second son. His descendants had the holiest work in the tabernacle, carrying the ark and the sacred furniture on poles, and even they would die if they touched those things.

kohathites.title: Kohathites
kohathites.about: Levi's son living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
kohathites.note: One of the three Levitical divisions, descended from Kohath. They carried the holiest furnishings, the ark among them, on poles and not in a cart, and 2 Samuel 6 shows what happened when that rule was broken. They camped south of the tabernacle. Moses, Aaron and Samuel were all Kohathites.

korah.title: Korah
korah.about: Aaron's adversary living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
korah.note: A Levite who led a revolt against Moses and Aaron, with more than two hundred fifty leading Israelites behind him, all saying the whole community was holy and Moses had no special claim. The ground opened and took Korah and his family alive, and fire burned up the rest. Israel complained about it the very next day.

leviite.title: Leviite
leviite.about: Jacob's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
leviite.note: An old spelling of Levite, found in a few manuscripts and translations for the tribe of Levi.

libni.title: Libni
libni.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
libni.note: Gershon's son, Levi's grandson, and the head of one of the Levitical clans.

machir.title: Machir
machir.about: Manasseh's son living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
machir.note: Manasseh's son. His clan, the Machirites, were such fighters that Machir's name can stand for the whole half-tribe of Manasseh east of the Jordan.

mahlah.title: Mahlah
mahlah.about: Woman living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
mahlah.note: Zelophehad had five daughters and no son, and Mahlah was one of them; their plea to Moses to inherit his land changed the law.

mahlites.title: Mahlites
mahlites.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
mahlites.note: The Levites from Mahli, son of Merari. With the Mushites they looked after the frame of the tabernacle.

malchiel.title: Malchiel
malchiel.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
malchiel.note: He was Asher's son, and his descendants made up one of the clans of Asher in the genealogies.

malchielite.title: Malchielite
malchielite.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
malchielite.note: The clan from Malchiel, of the tribe of Asher, counted in the wilderness census.

manasseh.title: Manasseh
manasseh.about: Joseph's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
manasseh.note: Joseph's elder son, whom Jacob took as his own and blessed. His name went to one of Israel's twelve tribes, and from Numbers through Joshua and Chronicles most of his verses are about that tribe and its land.

mattanah.title: Mattanah
mattanah.note: "A gift." Israel camped here between the desert and the borders of Moab, in the same short itinerary that has the well springing up at Beer. It is generally placed in the Wadi Waleh.

medeba.title: Medeba
medeba.note: An old Moabite town given to Reuben. Joab beat the Ammonites and their Aramean allies near it in David's time, and Moab later took it back, which Isaiah mourns in his oracle against Moab. Today it is Madaba in Jordan, known for a sixth-century Byzantine floor mosaic that is the oldest surviving map of the Holy Land.

merari.title: Merari
merari.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
merari.note: Levi's third son. His descendants had the heavy parts of the tabernacle, the frames, bars, pillars and bases, which went by cart instead of being carried.

midian.title: Midian
midian.note: A people descended from Abraham through Keturah, and they keep turning up in different roles. Midianite traders bought Joseph. Moses found a home and a wife, Zipporah, in Midian. Later they oppressed Israel until Gideon beat them.

milcah-2.title: Milcah
milcah-2.about: Woman living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
milcah-2.note: A different woman from Nahor's wife. This Milcah is one of the five sisters in Numbers 27 who asked for their father's land.

miriam.title: Miriam
miriam.about: Moses' sister living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
miriam.note: Moses and Aaron's older sister, and a prophetess. She watched over the baby Moses in the reeds of the Nile, and after the crossing of the sea she led Israel's women in song.

moab.title: Moab
moab.note: East of the Dead Sea, the nation descended from Lot through his elder daughter. Israel and Moab went back and forth between enemies and kin: Balak hired Balaam to curse Israel, and yet Ruth, a Moabite, became King David's great-grandmother. King Mesha's own inscription on the Moabite Stone records the wars with Israel that 2 Kings describes.

moses.title: Moses
moses.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
moses.note: Born a Hebrew slave in Egypt and raised in Pharaoh's house, he killed an Egyptian overseer and ran to Midian, where he kept sheep for forty years. God called him back from the burning bush to face Pharaoh and lead Israel out. He gave them the law at Sinai, led them forty years in the wilderness, and died at a hundred and twenty within sight of the promised land.

mushites.title: Mushites
mushites.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
mushites.note: They came from Mushi, son of Merari, and with their fellow Levites they looked after the frames, bars and pillars of the tabernacle.

naaman-2.title: Naaman
naaman-2.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
naaman-2.note: Numbers and 1 Chronicles name him twice, and he is a man from the wilderness years.

naamites.title: Naamites
naamites.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
naamites.note: From Naaman, Bela's son and Benjamin's grandson. The Numbers 26 census counts them as a clan.

nadab.title: Nadab
nadab.about: Priest living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
nadab.note: Aaron's eldest son. He and his brother Abihu offered unauthorised fire before the Lord and were struck dead.

nahaliel.title: Nahaliel
nahaliel.note: "Torrent of God," one of Israel's camps on the border of Moab. It is often placed at the Wadi Zarqa Ma'in east of the Dead Sea, known for its hot springs.

naphtali.title: Naphtali
naphtali.about: Jacob's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
naphtali.note: Jacob's sixth son, born to Rachel's servant Bilhah. His tribe settled in northern Galilee, the land Isaiah says will see a great light, and Matthew ties that to Jesus starting his work there.

nemuel.title: Nemuel
nemuel.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
nemuel.note: In the Numbers 26 census, a Nemuel is counted in Reuben's line, and the clan record says nothing more.

nemuel-2.title: Nemuel
nemuel-2.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
nemuel-2.note: A man from the wilderness years. Numbers names him once.

nemuelite.title: Nemuelite
nemuelite.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
nemuelite.note: The clan from Nemuel, son of Simeon, in the Numbers 26 census. Genesis calls the same man Jemuel.

noah-2.title: Noah
noah-2.about: Woman living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
noah-2.note: Not the man of the flood. This Noah was one of the five daughters of Zelophehad who went to Moses and won the right to inherit their father's land, since there was no son.

non.title: Non
non.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
non.note: Joshua's father, of the tribe of Ephraim, more usually spelled Nun and hardly ever seen outside the phrase "Joshua son of Nun."

nophah.title: Nophah
nophah.note: An old victory song in Numbers 21:27-30 celebrates the Amorite king Sihon taking Moabite land, and Nophah is one of the towns it names. Israel then defeated Sihon.

oboth.title: Oboth
oboth.note: Israel camped at Oboth after the bronze serpent. Where exactly it sat along the route is not known.

og.title: Og
og.about: King living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
og.note: King of Bashan and, in Deuteronomy, the last of the Rephaim, with a bed over thirteen feet long. Israel beat him and took his whole kingdom.

onan.title: Onan
onan.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
onan.note: Judah's second son. Custom required him to father a child for his dead brother through the widow Tamar. He made sure it never happened, and God put him to death for it.

ozni.title: Ozni
ozni.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
ozni.note: He was a son of Gad, and the Oznite clan counted in the wilderness census came from him. Genesis 46:16 calls him Ezbon.

pallu.title: Pallu
pallu.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
pallu.note: Reuben's son. His descendants, the Palluites, were one of the clans counted in the wilderness.

palluites.title: Palluites
palluites.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
palluites.note: Pallu's descendants, a clan of Reuben counted in the wilderness census, and listed once.

peor.title: Peor
peor.note: Balak took Balaam up this peak in Moab for one last try at cursing Israel. It came out a blessing again, the one about a star and a scepter rising out of Israel.

perez.title: Perez
perez.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
perez.note: Judah's son by Tamar. He pushed out ahead of his twin Zerah, though Zerah's hand had already been marked with a scarlet thread as the firstborn. His line runs through Boaz to David.

pharzites.title: Pharzites
pharzites.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
pharzites.note: The clan of Pharez, Judah's son by his daughter-in-law Tamar, counted in the census of Numbers 26. Boaz, Jesse and David came out of this line.

phinehas.title: Phinehas
phinehas.about: High Priest living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
phinehas.note: Aaron's grandson, Eleazar's son. When Israel was being struck by a plague for idolatry and sexual sin with Moabite women, Phinehas drove a spear through an Israelite man and a Midianite woman together, and the plague stopped.

phuvah.title: Phuvah
phuvah.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
phuvah.note: Issachar's son, usually spelled Puvah, in the genealogies of Genesis and Numbers.

pisgah.title: Pisgah
pisgah.note: Moses looked out over the promised land from the top of Pisgah before he died. Balak had brought Balaam up the same ridge in Moab to curse Israel's camp. It belongs to the range called Abarim.

punites.title: Punites
punites.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
punites.note: The clan of Puvah, Issachar's son, counted in the census of Numbers 26.

reuben.title: Reuben
reuben.about: Jacob's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
reuben.note: Jacob's firstborn. He slept with one of his father's concubines and lost the birthright for it, and Jacob had not forgotten it on his deathbed.

sallai.title: Sallai
sallai.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
sallai.note: A common name after the exile, and this one turns up in Nehemiah's lists of the families who came back.

sarah-2.title: Sarah
sarah-2.about: Woman living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
sarah-2.note: Not Abraham's wife but a different woman, named in the family lists at Genesis 46:17, Numbers 26:46 and 1 Chronicles 7:30, from the years in Egypt and the wilderness.

sardites.title: Sardites
sardites.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
sardites.note: Zebulun's firstborn was Sered, and the Sardites were his clan, counted in the census of Numbers 26.

seir.title: Seir
seir.note: A rough range of mountains east of the Arabah. It runs from the bottom of the Dead Sea toward the Gulf of Aqabah. The Horites lived there first, and Esau's descendants pushed them out.

sered.title: Sered
sered.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
sered.note: Zebulun's son, who went down to Egypt with Jacob's family and from whom the Seredites came.

shaul-2.title: Shaul
shaul-2.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
shaul-2.note: Genesis and 3 other books name him 4 times, and he is a man from the wilderness years.

shaulites.title: Shaulites
shaulites.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
shaulites.note: The clan of Shaul, Simeon's son by a Canaanite woman, counted in the census of Numbers 26.

shechem-3.title: Shechem
shechem-3.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
shechem-3.note: A different Shechem from the prince, named in the clan lists at Numbers 26:31 and Joshua 17:2.

shelah.title: Shelah
shelah.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
shelah.note: Judah's third son by his Canaanite wife. Judah held him back from marrying Tamar, the widow, as custom said he should. That broken promise is what drove Tamar to disguise herself.

shelanites.title: Shelanites
shelanites.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
shelanites.note: The clan that came from Shelah, Judah's son by Bath-shua, counted in the census of Numbers 26.

shemida.title: Shemida
shemida.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
shemida.note: Gilead's son and Manasseh's great-grandson, and his descendants made one of the clans of Manasseh.

shemidaites.title: Shemidaites
shemidaites.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
shemidaites.note: The clan of Shemida, Manasseh's descendant through Gilead, in the Numbers 26 census.

shephuphan.title: Shephuphan
shephuphan.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
shephuphan.note: Bela's son, Benjamin's grandson. The lists also call him Shupham, Shuppim and Muppim, and the Shuphamites came from him.

sheth.title: Sheth
sheth.about: Man living at the time before the Flood
sheth.note: Not a man. Balaam's oracle says a coming ruler of Israel will crush all the sons of Sheth, and most modern translations read it as sons of tumult.

shichemites.title: Shichemites
shichemites.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
shichemites.note: The clan of Shechem, Manasseh's grandson through Gilead, counted in Numbers 26. They share the name of the city of Shechem.

shillem.title: Shillem
shillem.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
shillem.note: Son of Naphtali. He went down to Egypt with Jacob, and his clan was counted again in the wilderness. Chronicles calls him Shallum.

shillemites.title: Shillemites
shillemites.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
shillemites.note: The clan of Shillem, Naphtali's son, in the Numbers 26 census.

shimron.title: Shimron
shimron.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
shimron.note: A son of Issachar, and the Shimronites took their name from him.

shimronites.title: Shimronites
shimronites.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
shimronites.note: The clan of Shimron, Issachar's son, counted in Numbers 26.

shittim.title: Shittim
shittim.note: Israel's last camp before crossing into Canaan, on the plain of Moab across from Jericho. It was there that the men were drawn into idolatry with Moabite women.

shuham.title: Shuham
shuham.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
shuham.note: Dan's son, and the only clan Dan had came from him.

shuhamites.title: Shuhamites
shuhamites.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
shuhamites.note: Dan's one recorded clan in the wilderness census, the family of Shuham, who is also called Hushim.

shuni.title: Shuni
shuni.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
shuni.note: Gad's son, who went down to Egypt with Jacob's family and from whom the Shunites came.

shunites.title: Shunites
shunites.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
shunites.note: The clan of Shuni, Gad's son, counted in the Numbers 26 census.

shuphamite.title: Shuphamite
shuphamite.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
shuphamite.note: One of Benjamin's clans in the Numbers 26 census, descended from Shupham, whose name is also spelled Shephupham.

shuthalhites.title: Shuthalhites
shuthalhites.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
shuthalhites.note: One of Ephraim's clans in the wilderness census, the family of Shuthelah.

shuthelah.title: Shuthelah
shuthelah.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
shuthelah.note: Ephraim's son, and his descendants were counted as a clan in the wilderness.

sihon.title: Sihon
sihon.about: King living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
sihon.note: An Amorite king. Israel asked to pass through his land, and he attacked them instead. It cost him his kingdom east of the Jordan.

simeon.title: Simeon
simeon.about: Jacob's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
simeon.note: Jacob's second son. With his brother Levi he killed the men of Shechem after their sister Dinah was raped. Jacob held it against them on his deathbed.

sinai.title: Sinai
sinai.note: Also called Horeb. Israel camped at the foot of the mountain for about a year after the exodus, and the law came down through Moses here.

tahan-2.title: Tahan
tahan-2.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
tahan-2.note: From him came the Tahanites, one of Ephraim's clans in the census of Numbers 26. Chronicles puts him as Telah's son rather than Ephraim's.

tahanites.title: Tahanites
tahanites.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
tahanites.note: Ephraim's clan through Tahan, counted in the Numbers 26 census.

tirzah-2.title: Tirzah
tirzah-2.about: Woman living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
tirzah-2.note: She was the youngest of Zelophehad's five daughters, named with her sisters each time the family's inheritance comes up.

tola.title: Tola
tola.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
tola.note: Here the verses are the man from the family lists, not the judge. He is in Genesis 46:13 among those who went down to Egypt, and in the Numbers 26 census and 1 Chronicles 7.

tolaites.title: Tolaites
tolaites.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
tolaites.note: Issachar's clan through Tola, his firstborn, in the Numbers 26 census.

urim.title: Urim
urim.note: The Urim and Thummim sat in the high priest's breastpiece. They were used to put yes-or-no questions to God. How they actually worked, nobody knows.

zarah.title: Zarah
zarah.about: Judah's son living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
zarah.note: Judah's son by Tamar, Perez's twin. His hand came out first and the midwife tied a scarlet thread on it, and then Perez was born ahead of him.

zarah-5.title: Zarah
zarah-5.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
zarah-5.note: A man from the wilderness years, named twice across Numbers and 1 Chronicles.

zarchite.title: Zarchite
zarchite.about: Judah's son living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
zarchite.note: A descendant of Zerah. It shows up in the census lists and the rosters in Chronicles and never attaches to anyone well known.

zarchite-2.title: Zarchite
zarchite-2.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
zarchite-2.note: Numbers names him once, and he is a man from the wilderness years.

zared.title: Zared
zared.note: The Zered valley, the brook Israel crossed near the end of the wandering on the way around Edom and Moab.

zebulonite.title: Zebulonite
zebulonite.about: Jacob's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
zebulonite.note: Someone of the tribe of Zebulun. In Judges it is Elon, who judged Israel ten years and was buried at Aijalon in Zebulun's land.

zebulun.title: Zebulun
zebulun.about: Jacob's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
zebulun.note: Jacob's tenth son and Leah's last. His tribe's land ran up to the Sea of Galilee, and Isaiah names it with Naphtali as the place where a light would dawn, which Matthew applies to Jesus in Galilee.

zelophehad.title: Zelophehad
zelophehad.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
zelophehad.note: He died in the wilderness with five daughters and no sons. They went to Moses and asked for their father's land, and they got it, and the law of inheritance changed because of them.

zephon.title: Zephon
zephon.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
zephon.note: Gad's son. His descendants were the Zephonites, and Genesis 46:16 spells him Ziphion.

zephonites.title: Zephonites
zephonites.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
zephonites.note: Gad's clan through Zephon, counted in the Numbers 26 census.

zimri-4.title: Zimri
zimri-4.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
zimri-4.note: One of 4 men called Zimri. This one is a man from the wilderness years, named once in Numbers.

zin.title: Zin
zin.note: The Wilderness of Zin, where Kadesh lay. Miriam died there, and there Moses struck the rock in anger when he had been told to speak to it.

zippor.title: Zippor
zippor.about: Moabite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
zippor.note: Balak's father. Balak was the Moabite king who hired Balaam to curse Israel.

zur-3.title: Zur
zur-3.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
zur-3.note: One of 3 men called Zur. This one is a man from the wilderness years, named once in Numbers.
